hero.title:
Expand your AT.field.
Visualize the Future of AI.
hero.subtitle: AT.field is a native macOS AI terminal cockpit for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, aider, SSH, Serial ports, Git diffs, localhost preview, and AI Agent workflows. When an AI agent changes files, generates reports, or starts a web app from the terminal, you can review the result in the right-side Sidecar instead of constantly switching to Finder, browser, Preview, or VS Code.
showcase.title: One place for all terminal work
showcase.desc: Real app screenshots showing Sidecar preview, Git diff, localhost, SSH, Serial, split terminal, and floating windows.
showcase.1.title: Navigator · Core · Sidecar, All in One Window
showcase.1.desc: Left Navigator for project browsing, center Core for commands, right Sidecar for real-time Markdown rendering. Three panels working together — terminal and preview never separated.
showcase.2.title: Preview ↔ Edit at a Click
showcase.2.desc: Sidecar supports Preview (real-time Markdown rendering) and Edit (direct source code editing). Pick a file, view it, edit it — no need for a separate editor.
showcase.3.title: Full Project Tree + Git Diff in Sidecar
showcase.3.desc: Browse multi-level project structure (ATF / atf-mcp / website / scripts) on the left. Git diff results render directly in Sidecar as colorized previews — no context switching needed.
showcase.4.desc: When the terminal detects a URL, open it instantly in the right-side WebKit sandbox. npm run dev, Vite, any HTTP service — edit a line, see it live, all without leaving the keyboard.
showcase.4.title: localhost One-Click into Sidecar Browser
showcase.5.title: SSH & Serial, unified connection hub
showcase.5.desc: Manage SSH hosts and Serial devices (/dev/tty.*) as first-class sessions. Switching tabs does not drop background connections, useful for embedded, robotics, homelab, and infra work.
showcase.6.title: Multiple Terminals Side by Side in One Tab
showcase.6.desc: ⌘D splits the terminal horizontally. Each pane has its own PTY session. Compare outputs from multiple machines or run different commands in parallel — no extra windows needed.
showcase.7.title: Detach Tabs as Floating Windows, Pin to Top
showcase.7.desc: Drag any tab out of the main window to create a floating terminal. Pin it to stay on top of all Spaces. SSH sessions and long-running scripts never get buried.

showcase.img_alt.3: Full project tree with Git Diff preview
showcase.img_alt.7: Detached floating window pinned on top
features.title: Core features
features.desc: Keep your terminal-first workflow, then add file preview, diff review, localhost preview, SSH / Serial management, and MCP automation.
features.1.title: Three-pane cockpit
features.1.desc: Navigator, terminal, and Sidecar work in one window. Manage files and connections on the left, run commands in the center, review results on the right.
features.2.title: Sidecar preview / edit
features.2.desc: Preview Markdown, images, video, HTML, JSON, and PDF, or edit source files with syntax highlighting.
features.3.title: SSH & Serial hub
features.3.desc: Manage SSH hosts and Serial devices (/dev/tty.*) as first-class sessions without dropping background connections.
features.4.title: Terminal output detection
features.4.desc: Detect file paths, localhost URLs, images, PDFs, HTML, and diffs from terminal output, then open them directly in Sidecar.
